title: Reference station keeping
change: Assumed candidate thermal system, curved solar array and nominal mission.

title: Heading rotated 90°
change: Only the heading offset changes; prescribed wind and shaft-power profile stay the same. No yaw maneuver power is added.

title: Radiators exposed to Sun
change: Only the direct solar exposure factor changes from 0.05 to 1. Albedo and IR remain present in both cases.

title: Air 10 K colder
change: Only air temperature shifts by -10 K; prescribed Earth/sky IR are held fixed for a controlled sensitivity, not a complete cold-weather bound.

title: All heaters disabled
change: Only heater enable changes. Temperature-dependent charge permission and battery efficiency remain active.

title: Twice the payload electrical load
change: Only the payload input profile doubles; RF export fraction stays 35%. Shared converter/battery/structure paths respond.

title: Strap conductance ×0.35
change: Only avionics and payload radiator-strap conductances change; capacity, areas, load and environment stay fixed.
